subject: Orchid Systems onboarding — PO metadata, spend cap, and line item corrections
snippet: Confirming PO number issuance and correcting two SKU line items against the spend cap
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchid-systems.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@orchid-systems.com, Aaron Feld <aaron.feld@orchid-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New supplier onboarding — Orchid Systems (initial info)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding packet (orchid_onboarding_form_v3.pdf). We plan to start with Redwood in March and need guidance on how you prefer PO issuance and spend cap limits.

A few specifics from our side:
- Initial order window: Q2 usage estimate ~$85k monthly
- Prefer a single PO per quarter if possible (finance request)
- Need to ensure two SKUs (OR-API-STD and OR-API-PRO) are split across separate line items for internal accounting

Can you confirm the PO process and any templates we should use? Also let us know if there are any vendor setup fields that commonly trip up issuance so we can pre-populate them.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Strategic Procurement
Orchid Systems

Attachment: orchid_onboarding_form_v3.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchid-systems.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — Orchid Systems (initial info)

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call.

Thanks for sending the form. Quick answers up front: we can support a single PO per quarter, but our finance team needs line-item granularity to reconcile spend buckets. Typical items that cause issues: missing tax IDs, ambiguous SKU mapping, and mismatched spend cap fields between sales and procurement.

Next steps I recommend:
1) I will kick off supplier setup with Procurement (cc'd: Aditya).
2) Please confirm the exact invoice remit address and the preferred PO reference string (e.g., ORCHID-Q2-2026).
3) I'll request an initial provisional PO number while we finish account setup; that will allow your finance team to start routing invoices.

I'll attach an internal PO template so you can see the fields we populate.

Thanks — Priyom
Business Development, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: internal_po_template.pdf

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchid-systems.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@orchid-systems.com, Aaron Feld <aaron.feld@orchid-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — Orchid Systems (initial info)

Thanks, Priyom — attached confirms remit and PO reference. A couple of clarifications we need on your side before we finalize:

- When issuing the provisional PO, can you ensure the spend cap field is set to "Per-quarter cap" rather than a rolling monthly cap? Finance will reject otherwise.
- Line items: we need the OR-API-STD item to be listed first with quantity/price broken out for internal cost centers (see lineitem_corrections_77921.xlsx). In the draft the PRO SKU was combined into a single line; could you split them into two lines and include the internal cost center tags you use (e.g., CC-RESEARCH / CC-PROD)?

We'll need the provisional PO number to reference in our internal requester system; happy to wait 48 hours if you need Procurement to validate fields.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: PO_77921_signed.pdf, lineitem_corrections_77921.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Orchid Systems onboarding — PO metadata, spend cap, and line item corrections

Laura / Aditya — forwarding Orchid's reply. They explicitly request: set spend cap to "Per-quarter cap" and split two SKUs into separate line items with internal cost center tags (CC-RESEARCH, CC-PROD). They attached a signed PO (PO_77921_signed.pdf) and a line-item correction spreadsheet.

Can Procurement issue a provisional PO number (preferably 77921 if available) and confirm the account fields will pass finance validation? If there are any gaps I'll loop Marissa to help with expedite/credit approval.

Key context for approval: estimated Q2 spend ~85k/month but they want one PO per quarter; our billing needs per-line accounting for revenue recognition and usage tagging.

Thanks — Priyom

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Elena Morales <elena.morales@orchid-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Orchid Systems onboarding — PO metadata, spend cap, and line item corrections

Hi all — procurement processed the setup and we've reserved PO number 77921 as requested. Actions completed: 

- Supplier account created with tax and remit details from the onboarding form.
- Provisional PO issued: PO 77921 (attached as PO_77921_signed.pdf). This is set as a Per-quarter spend cap for Q2 2026. Cap value on the PO: $255,000 (Q2 total).
- Line items split and annotated: OR-API-STD (CC-RESEARCH) and OR-API-PRO (CC-PROD). Unit prices and quantities reflect the signed PO; see attached lineitem_corrections_77921.xlsx for the final mapping.

Elena — can you confirm receipt and that the invoice routing matches your ERP? If you need us to reissue with a different PO reference string for your internal system we can do that, but the master PO number in Redwood will remain 77921.

Marissa — tagging you in case Orchid requests expedited invoice credits or any allocation changes during Q2; please advise.

Thanks — Aditya
Senior Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_77921_signed.pdf, lineitem_corrections_77921.xlsx
